item.title: Israel bars U.S. citizens over criticism and ties to Palestinian activists, lawyers say
item.description: Travelers from the U.S. and other nations are denied entry to Israel after interrogations about their links to Palestinians, plans to visit the occupied West Bank and opinions of Israel, lawyers say.

item.title: ICE says it now has enough body cameras. And, Congress averts shutdown before midterms
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says it now has enough body cameras to equip all of its agents. And, Congress votes to fund the government, averting a government shutdown ahead of the midterms.

item.title: He died of 'natural causes.' But his mother says she knows what killed him: heat
item.description: When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: U.S. military strikes rock Iran for a second day in a row, Trump attempts to combat rising gas prices as midterm approaches, Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary.

item.title: How will tariffs affect the midterms? In this Michigan border town, it's complicated
item.description: The recent trade war between the U.S. and Canada has both economic and political implications for Michigan given it's the state's top trade partner.
